name: yore-games
description: yore-tw.com: the entry site in site/ plus three independent games, each its own npm workspace. Shared tooling only (Vite, TypeScript, Playwright); no shared game code.

scripts.site: npm run build && rm -rf dist-site && cp -r site dist-site && cp -r meowcaron/dist dist-site/meowcaron && cp -r souls-in-abyss/dist dist-site/souls-in-abyss
